parsed.target: Identify Jeroboam’s consecration of anyone as priests of the high places as the practice counted as sin to his family.
required_answer_components: Appointing or consecrating anyone as priests, rather than restricting who could serve.

relations.meaning: Identify the practice characterized as sin.
relations.reason: The respondent must recover the offending practice, not merely name Jeroboam or describe the consequences of his sin. The answer must preserve the unrestricted scope of appointing anyone as priests.

relations.meaning: The sin is attributed to the house of Jeroboam.
relations.reason: This specifies whose sin is being asked about and connects the question to the passage’s characterization of the sin of Jeroboam’s house.

parsed.note: The target is conservatively inferred from the supplied question and original answer; no explicit intended target was provided. Verse 13:33 describes Jeroboam appointing priests from every class and ordaining anyone who desired to serve at the high places. Verse 13:34 identifies this as the sin of his house, supporting the fixed answer. The resulting extermination and destruction are not requested answer components.
